purpose: Choose an external-price control family before pass-through estimation so the control is not selected after inspecting model fit.

preferred_direct_control.dataset: Eurostat sts_inpi_m — Import prices in industry, monthly data
evidence: Eurostat defines the indicator as monthly transaction-price development of imported industrial goods.
Under the European business-statistics framework euro-area countries are required to transmit import prices; only some non-euro EU/EFTA countries transmit them.

Current provider and dataset-mirror searches did not identify the standard Romania total-industry series. This is treated as non-confirmation, not proof that every possible Romanian subseries is absent.

preregistered_fallback.source_family: Eurostat International Trade in Goods Statistics — Indices by SITC/BEC/CPA
preregistered_fallback.target: Romania monthly import unit-value index for total imports from world, Eurostat IVU (2021=100)
rationale: Eurostat documents monthly and annual unit-value indices for imports and exports of each EU country, with short-term coverage beginning in January 2002.
The live Eurostat dissemination API for ext_st_27_2020msbec confirms Romania / imports / WORLD / TOTAL and exposes indic_et=IVU labelled 'Unit value index (2021=100)'.

The current short-term API extract exposes no separate currency dimension. The retained control is therefore identified by the exact provider dimensions and IVU concept, without inventing a RON-versus-EUR variant that the extract does not expose.
Unit-value indices are constructed from trade values and quantities and can move with product composition; they are an external-price proxy, not a pure transaction-price import-price index.
preregistered_fallback.materialisation_rule: Use exactly ext_st_27_2020msbec with freq=M, geo=RO, stk_flow=IMP, partner=WORLD, bclas_bec=TOTAL and indic_et=IVU. Do not substitute INT/CAP/CONS/CONS_TRA, a different partner aggregate, another indicator, or a post-fit-selected currency/product variant.
preregistered_fallback.dataset_label: Member States EU27 (from 2020) trade by BEC product group

live_product_boundary_probe.interpretation: The earlier screening conclusion that the Member-State short-term family lacked TOTAL was falsified by the live provider structure. The original ex-ante total-import/world fallback is available and no BEC subcategory choice is needed.

methodological_limits.rule_on_currency: Do not infer a currency denomination not exposed by the exact short-term dataset dimensions. Preserve the provider IVU concept and document Eurostat methodology separately.
